note: Real code bug, out of scope for a docs-only phase, two independent causes: (1) frontend/apps/web/src/features/rules/RuleEditor.tsx's emptyCondition() omits the 'type' discriminant backend/src/rules/types.rs's #[serde(tag = "type")] RuleCondition enum requires, so saving a freshly-added condition fails JSON deserialization; (2) RuleEditor.tsx's conditionOperators sends kebab-case ('starts-with', 'ends-with', 'matches-regex', 'not-contains') but backend/src/rules/types.rs's MatchOperator is #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] ('startsWith', 'endsWith', 'regex') and has no 'notContains' variant at all -- so 4 of the 6 operator choices fail deserialization regardless of whether the condition is new or pre-existing, not just 'not contains' on new rows as an earlier draft of this note understated (caught by phase-1's Tier-3 review). Documented as a known-issue callout in docs/user-guide.md's Rules Studio section instead of silently claiming the feature works.

README.md documents 'just outdated' (cargo-outdated + pnpm outdated). The pnpm side works; cargo-outdated 0.17.0 fails locally with 'No such file or directory' from its internal rustc-wrapper temp script against the Rust 1.97.0 toolchain -- looks like a cargo-outdated/toolchain compatibility issue, not an emailibrium bug, and the recipe itself is correctly documented. Left README unchanged; noting here in case it reproduces for other contributors on 1.97.0.

`just lint-docs`'s markdownlint-cli2 invocation ('**/*.md' '#node_modules') does not actually exclude node_modules -- it lints thousands of pre-existing errors inside vendored packages/*/node_modules/**/README.md files repo-wide. Confirmed unrelated to any file this phase touched (zero errors reference docs/api/** or docs/audit/**). The '#node_modules' glob-negation syntax markdownlint-cli2 expects is likely wrong (should be a .markdownlintignore entry or a proper '!**/node_modules/**' glob) -- fix in justfile's lint-docs recipe.

.autopilot/profile.yml's commands.lint/build/test comments claim backend+frontend coverage ('backend cargo clippy -D warnings + frontend eslint', 'backend cargo build + frontend turbo build', 'backend cargo test + frontend vitest run'), but the actual root justfile recipes (just lint / just build / just test) only run Turborepo (frontend) targets -- there is no backend cargo build/test/clippy in the top-level dependency chain, only in commands.test_integration/test_frontend which explicitly --justfile backend/justfile. This means the gate's own Tier-1 checks silently do not compile or test the backend on any future phase that touches backend/src/** unless that phase's author independently runs cargo build/test/clippy by hand, as this phase did to verify no regression. Worth fixing profile.yml's commands (point lint/build/test at commands that cover both workspaces, or split into explicit backend_/frontend_ command pairs) before a code-touching phase relies on the gate alone.
